name: Meta4MPCXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: Plays 4ms MetaModule-format patches (VCV Rack patches exported with the MetaModule hub) with 4ms's own open-source patch player and 215 built-in modules: every parameter on Q-Link pages, MIDI and the Force's clock into the patch, pads and keys to the hub's gate/CV inputs, patch outs 3-8 as MIDI for a CV track, and Wi-Fi patch upload from VCV Rack.
